items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: And it was Hank Jones, Slam Stewart, Jerry Fuller, a wonderful drummer from Canada, and myself.

ctx.x: Yeah, because these people that are coming I hope, tomorrow night, from Chase Design, Dave Chase was a frustrated vibraphone player. And every year for about five years he would get me to hire six or five of the leading jazz players in America. I had every one of them playing in Skaneateles. He had a barn party in his barn. And Hank came and played. And so Dave said, “Well what do you want?” So he said, “I’ve just bought this farm, I’d like to have a horse.” Well David had a lot of polo ponies, you know, he was a…

Before we run out of time I wanted to ask you a question I’ve been thinking about regarding the vibes. If I went to a set of vibes and pushed down the pedal and hit a note with the mallet, and then you went to the vibes and hit it, would it sound that much different?
